# Honorific

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Honorific`](gmeow-Honorific.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Honorific>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A title or form of address (Mr, Mx, Dr, -san, Sri, Sayyid, …). A value, not a subclass. Each carries a [`gmeow:honorificPosition`](../properties/gmeow-honorificPosition.md) (prefix/suffix) and, where applicable, a [`gmeow:honorificClass`](../properties/gmeow-honorificClass.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Honorific`](gmeow-Honorific.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the open value vocabulary for a title or form of address (Mr, Mx, Dr, -san, Sri, Sayyid, …) — referenced from [`gmeow:honorific`](../properties/gmeow-honorific.md) on a person, or extended with a new individual for a non-Western or gender-neutral title not yet seeded.

### Avoid when

- Avoid inferring an honorific from, or asserting one to imply, gender identity, gender expression, or sex assigned at birth — honorifics are a sex/gender-independent form of address; and avoid minting a subclass per title (titles are individuals).

### How to use

- Attach a seeded [`Honorific`](gmeow-Honorific.md) to a person with [`gmeow:honorific`](../properties/gmeow-honorific.md); mint a new one as an individual with [`gmeow:honorificPosition`](../properties/gmeow-honorificPosition.md) (prefix/suffix) and, where applicable, [`gmeow:honorificClass`](../properties/gmeow-honorificClass.md), rather than a subclass.

### Examples

- ex:person [`gmeow:honorific`](../properties/gmeow-honorific.md) [`gmeow:honorificMx`](../individuals/gmeow-honorificMx.md).
